curriculumRow: Урок 3, сессия 35 · тип: контраст · грамматика: `this` против `these`: один или несколько · новые слова: photo, album, frame · момент сцены: выбираем украшения для стены
cambridgeEvidence: Cambridge digest section this/that/these/those: this selects one nearby countable item and these selects multiple nearby items. Singular naming uses This is a/an + singular noun; plural naming uses These are + plural noun; demonstrative+noun requests use this photo / these frames without an article.
scene: In a photo-framing workshop, the learner chooses prints and frames for a new apartment wall while using an album to review the options. One item and several groups sit on the near workbench; at the order counter the learner distinguishes this from these and selects the items.

priorLearnerFacingScan.evidence: Fresh full-byte scan of all 68 current RU+UK learner-facing files S01-S34 (900579 bytes), including intros, tasks, translations, distractors, feedback and builder notes. Exact English target forms photo/photos, album/albums and frame/frames are absent. RU/UK photography mentions in S05 and the broader picture gloss in S26 were explicitly inspected; they do not introduce the English lexical item photo. All 34 scenes and primary operations were compared.
observedOverlaps: S05 uses RU/UK words for photographs as scene-language props but never presents English photo/photos.

S26 defines picture as картина and uses a broader prompt ‘картина или фотография в раме’; the English target photo remains unintroduced and S35 must explicitly distinguish a photo/print from the earlier picture wording without claiming that the concepts never overlapped.

introTargets.practiceLink: Ground photo/photos and exact RU/UK meaning at the near workbench, then score a distinct one-versus-several photo action without repeating the intro task verbatim.
Ground album/albums and meaning in the same workshop, then score the opposite-number album contrast in a distinct supported family.
Ground frame/frames and meaning beside the selected prints, then score the opposite-number frame contrast before the changed-counter request.

independentFinal.target: This photo, please. This album, please. These frames, please.
independentFinal.independence: At a second order counter after the items have been regrouped, RU/UK cues identify one print, one album and several frames. The learner makes all three requests before model audio, with no ready English and no ‘independently’ process label; each chain changes from intro naming to final selection.

boundedRewritePacket.authorization: Rewrite only; this receipt does not approve the current learner-facing RU/UK bytes.
requiredChanges: Rewrite the first two scene sentences so the framing workshop, learner, near items and wall-selection purpose are immediately clear, while the album is a real review/ordering tool rather than something falsely placed in the wall composition.

Make Intro 1 ground photo with exact meaning and immediate same-scene use; keep the three planned intro targets These are photos, This is an album and These are frames, each feeding a distinct practice operation.

Turn task 8 into a genuine multi-token phrase_builder using whole-word tiles, and eliminate duplicated normalized primary targets across tasks instead of relabeling one-word morphology as phrase construction.
Replace decorative card endings, especially pages ‘holding memories straighter’ and the apartment ‘arguing with a level’, with short precise standalone RU/UK definitions or useful word-linked humor.

Replace the final with the changed order-counter transfer This photo, please. This album, please. These frames, please.; cue the three quantities and selection action only in RU/UK before model audio.
Remove самостоятельно / самостійно and any equivalent learner-facing claim about absence of help; prompts must state the concrete workshop action.

Keep 12–20 meaningful tasks (target 17), all six active families, exact audio meanings without added distance, one correct atomic choice, response-specific feedback, and no S36 tree/flower/bicycle or new that/those listening focus.

confirmedDefects: The final omits album completely and therefore cannot retrieve all three intro-word chains.
The final remains at the same near workbench and supplies ready English, so it does not demonstrate a changed-context independent transfer.
RU/UK final prompts use forbidden самостоятельно / самостійно process language.
Task 8 is a one-token plural-form choice declared as phrase_builder instead of multi-token phrase assembly.
This is an album is duplicated as the complete scored target in tasks 13 and 15, contrary to the learner-task non-repeat contract.
The opening says an album will enter a wall composition, leaving the practical role of the album incoherent in the stated scene.
The album and frame cards end with decorative AI-like metaphors (‘pages hold memories straighter than memory’; the apartment argues with the level) that do not clarify the word.
